label: Spooltail Chameleon
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One independent square transparent Glaze pure-art asset. EMULSION ROOKERY, physical wildlife sculptures made entirely from continuous perforated PHOTOGRAPHIC CELLULOID FILM STRIPS. Our own ibis reference supplies only the material, palette and restrained macro lighting; create a wholly different subject. Thin springy translucent strips with clearly visible RECTANGULAR EMULSION FRAME WINDOWS and paired regular rows of small SQUARE SPROCKET HOLES along every major strip edge. Petrol-blue, teal, soft coral and copper dye transparencies, subtle photographic grain inside each window, thin amber-clear edges with restrained glossy reflections. Frame windows contain abstract dye gradients only, no pictures/writing/codes. Strips bend in crisp long loops, overlapping plates and pleats to CONSTRUCT the entire body; no ordinary skin or solid toy decorated with a film pattern. Genuine alpha through gaps and perforations. No fabric/feathers, fuzzy fibres, paper quilling, metal, glass, wet cellulose, smooth plastic toys, cinema equipment or standalone reels. Whole subject and all projecting extremities inside central70%, ample transparent space on all sides. No floor, exterior cast shadow, haze, opaque backing panel, border, collage, lettering, numbers, film edge codes, logos, dates, clock/battery/calendar pictures or UI. Readable singular silhouette at85px. SUBJECT: one whole recognizable CHAMELEON in natural side profile facing left, standing on a short gently bent bare twig. Low arched back, small familiar casque on its head, one tiny swivelling dark eye, long gently tapered mouth, four articulated grasping feet and an elegant complete tightly curled tail at right. Rounded body constructed from overlapping broad film strip panels that bend with the belly; thinner wrapped film forms legs and toes. Clear film frames and square perforation rows remain visible across the back, flank, head and curled tail. The plain twig is subordinate, no leaves/props. Preserve ordinary believable chameleon anatomy without extra horns, fins, eyes or fantasy organs; all toe groups, branch ends and entire curled tail inside generous transparent margins.
processing: Whole original uniformly contained within900px on transparent1024square. Alpha preserved, no subject crop/recolour/artistic edits.

references.purpose: Own accepted ibis supplies continuous perforated film material, palette and lighting only; a distinct new natural subject.
